_doc: Executable mirror of _SYSTEM/mure/BUILD-DOCTRINE.md — the company's directions of improvement. Authoritative human form is the .md; this is the machine-readable surface the recommender/ranker/grader read. Changing axes, vector weights, or rubrics is OWNER-GATED (axis A8b, see governance below). Read by mure/doctrine.mjs.

integrated: A8 split into A8a machinery / A8b goalposts

axes.name: Capability
axes.definition: the system can do something it couldn't before — new primitive/skill/role/substrate/lane
axes.regress: a capability rots, is lost, OR code is rewritten where an existing capability should have been reused (capability-first violation)
axes.signal: capability-scan delta; live lane probe; reuse-vs-rebuild check

axes.name: Reliability
axes.definition: the same work succeeds more often — fewer crashes/flakes/false-done
axes.advance: green suite; failure-rate down across cycles; no false-PASS
axes.regress: a regression, a new flake, a silent failure path

axes.name: Autonomy
axes.definition: the owner drives less — more work completes autonomously WITHOUT the owner having to clean up afterward
axes.advance: 5+ consecutive successful autonomous runs with no owner git-rollback or state-correction; manual-fire count down
axes.regress: manual intervention required to fix a broken state the cycle left behind
axes.signal: consecutive clean autonomous runs; owner-cleanup count (NOT just self-governable ratio — passing one's own gates is not autonomy)

axes.name: Quality
axes.definition: outputs more correct / better verified / higher craft
axes.advance: adversarial pass clean; local-evidence verdict; review findings down

axes.name: Efficiency
axes.regress: cost/time per outcome rises with no quality gain

axes.name: Compounding
axes.definition: the system gets smarter over time — knowledge captured, never-stale, re-discovery killed
axes.advance: findings reindexed; registries fresh; a procedure becomes a launcher
axes.regress: research evaporates; indexes stale; same thing re-derived
axes.signal: reindex events; registry freshness; launcher count

axes.name: Safety
axes.definition: the gates get stronger — blast better bounded, fewer ways to do harm
axes.advance: a new veto/guard; tighter scope; arming stays owner-gated
axes.regress: a gate weakens; blast widens; arming discipline slips

axes.name: Self-improvement (machinery)
axes.definition: the company improves its own ENGINE — loop hardening, the pool, roles, the assessor — NOT this doctrine
axes.advance: an owner-ratified change to roles/pool/assessor/loop that makes the engine better
axes.regress: the machinery ossifies; the company can't improve its engine

axes.name: Doctrine / goalposts
axes.definition: changing the axes, the vector, the rubrics, or the doctrine document itself — the company's definition of success
axes.advance: an OWNER-ratified doctrine change (the company may PROPOSE, never self-credit)
axes.regress: the company alters its own success metric to make its work look better

axes.name: External value
axes.definition: delivered work creates value outside the OS — venture/product/client outcome
axes.regress: promised external value undelivered or net-negative

axes.name: Observability
axes.definition: the owner can determine the exact internal state of the system from logs + dashboards WITHOUT reading code
axes.advance: a deterministic execution trace / state log added; a failure becomes explainable from logs alone; the dashboard surfaces it
axes.regress: a silent failure, an un-logged mutation, or hidden state
axes.signal: cycle failure explainable from logs alone; dashboard state-coverage

currentVector._note: The owner-tunable knob — which axes the company weights THIS phase. 0=ignore 1=baseline 2=push 3=primary-front. A7 is a non-tradeable floor; A8b is locked at 0 (owner moves the goalposts, never the company).

selectionRubric.directionFit: directionFit(J) = sum over axes of weight(A) * fit(J,A); a floor axis contributes 0 to the push, but a regression on it is a hard violation
selectionRubric.priority: priority(J) = OpenMass(J) + wDir * directionFit(J)   (wDir default 1.0, tunable — OpenMass and directionFit are on comparable scales)
selectionRubric.hardVeto: drop J from the AUTO-EXEC pool if directionFit(J) <= 0 AND OpenMass(J) < staleThreshold, OR if J would regress a floor axis
selectionRubric.governanceFilter: governance class is a FILTER not a score — owner-gated jobs are surfaced and held regardless of priority
selectionRubric.deterministic: strict arithmetic, no subjective urgency bands — an autonomous ranker needs arithmetic, not banding (GLM-5.2 review)
selectionRubric.generalization: fit is scored against axes, never job type — any job/role/substrate uses the identical rubric

assessmentRubric.rule_no_advance_without_evidence: a claimed advance/partial with no local proof (TERM_COUNT/FILE_COUNT/MATCH, green test, live probe) grades 'none' not 'advanced'
assessmentRubric.churnPenalty: high lines-touched / token-cost for a SMALL axis delta is penalized — the company must prefer small surgical wins over bloated rewrites that fake an advance via churn (GLM-5.2: blocks A2-reliability Goodharting by adding bulk)
assessmentRubric.a1_rewrite_is_regression: rewriting code where an existing capability should have been reused grades as an A1 regression (capability-first)
assessmentRubric.feedsRecommender: under-served axes (low cumulative advancement vs weight) become the recommender's target

governance.a8b_owner_only: A8b (changing the doctrine/axes/vector/rubrics) is weight 0 and strictly owner-gated — the company earns NO self-improvement credit for moving its own goalposts; A8a (engine machinery) is the only self-improvement axis a cycle can advance (GLM-5.2 review: closes the A8 self-credit loophole)
governance.rule: the company may PROPOSE axis/vector/rubric changes as an A8b job with evidence; only the OWNER ratifies. Editing axes, currentVector, or rubrics is an arming-class change to the success metric — held by owner-floor, exactly like arm/blender/owner-source jobs.
governance.inherits: mure/governance.mjs constitution veto — a self-improving company never moves its own goalposts (the Godel-Agent self-modification gap, applied to the success metric not just the safety gate). doctrine.mjs is READ-ONLY by construction.

queued_A8a: cycle self-assessment: cumulative axis advancement vs vector
